This eliminates distributed logic, improves maintainability, and makes the finalized robust configurations the new default.

changelog.author: Gemini System Engineer
changelog.description: Applied P856. Refactored the reasoning architecture to centralize all archetype-specific parameters into a single static object (`archetype_parameter_sets`). This eliminates distributed logic, improves maintainability, and makes the finalized robust configurations the new default.

changelog.author: LIC Engineering Team
changelog.description: Applied P855. Modified CONNECTION_REQ route to enable a targeted RAG strategy by default for non-job-specific messages, improving baseline personalization and reducing user friction.

changelog.author: LIC Engineering Team
changelog.description: Applied PATCH_LIC_8.5.4. Fixed critical bug where L1 transformer output failed when user selected 'Yes' for detailed reasoning. Root cause: mandatory high_signal_event flag dependency blocked L1 baseline rendering. Solution: Implemented dual-mode rendering strategy (baseline always + dynamic content conditional). Added l1_execution_fallback path, updated CFG-LSERIES-001 with L1 exception, added PREREQ-004 validation check, and enabled L1 execution diagnostics logging.

changelog.author: LIC Engineering Team
changelog.description: Applied P8.5.3. Replaced toggle table truncation logic with multi-table chunking to display all 7 K-nodes across 3 viewport-friendly tables (K.1-K.3, K.4-K.6, K.7). Maintains 4-column max per table for readability while providing complete reasoning configuration visibility.

changelog.author: LIC Quality Assurance Team
changelog.description: Applied P8.5.2: K.3 Comprehensive Grounding Hardening - Added 4 validation layers: (1) Pre-generation entity extraction with locked whitelists for companies, roles, and metrics; (2) Generation-time hard constraints to prevent violations; (3) Three new validation passes for metric source validation (LIC-QA-041), role drift detection (LIC-QA-042), and context coherence (LIC-QA-043); (4) Per-claim confidence scoring with 0.95 aggregate threshold. Prevents metric misattribution, team characterization drift, and unmapped claims.

changelog.author: LIC Quality Assurance Team
changelog.description: Applied P8.5.1: Quality Control Triad - Implemented K.3 entity grounding validation (LIC-QA-032-ENHANCED, LIC-QA-038-ENTITY), enforced Section 4 K-node header format (CFG-FORMAT-001), and replaced hardcoded toggle table schema with dynamic sourcing from canonical JSON file (CFG-RTSEF-001). Fixes: Entity hallucination in K.3, inconsistent header formatting, static schema maintenance burden.

changelog.author: Gemini System Engineer
changelog.description: Applied PATCH_LIC_8.4.0_v1.4. Hardened L-Series trace generation with a strict content validator and formatting rules. Enforced 1:1 schema adherence for the K.1 toggle table to prevent summarization or truncation. Corrected prompt sequencing.

changelog.author: Gemini System Engineer
changelog.description: Applied PATCH_LIC_8.3.1_D100. Replaced the Transformer v17 reasoning display (Dashboard, Summary, Detail) with the L1/L2/L3 dynamic intelligence framework. Enforces strict structural templates for all reasoning outputs and introduces conditional, high-signal ASCII diagram integration from Transformer Output v40 based on narrative relevance.

changelog.author: LIC Engineering Team
changelog.description: Applied PATCH_LIC_8.2.1_C099 to replace the unstructured reasoning toggle with a structured three-tier prompt (Dashboard, Summary, Detail) mapped to Transformer v17.

changelog.author: LIC Engineering Team
changelog.description: Applied PATCH v8.2 to fix 11 critical bugs in the reasoning visualization engine. Implemented a mandatory 5-stage reasoning template for all K-nodes, added a pre-flight validation checklist to prevent configuration hallucinations, and enforced post-execution tracing to ensure summaries reflect actual operations.

rendering_policy.fallback_strategy: If no high_signal_events detected, render baseline L1 template without dynamic ASCII/persona content from v40

options.label: L2 (Detailed Trace)

options.label: L3 (Full Technical Verbosity)

│    📊 Slide 2/N: [RAG] Executed {rag_internal_count} internal and {rag_external_count} external searches.            │

│ 🧐 Partners select the branch with the highest score that passes hard block validation.                          │

STAGE_2_HARD_BLOCKS.BLOCK_003: IF seniority_level >= VP_LEVEL AND primary_domain != RECRUITING_TA THEN recipient_type IN [EXECUTIVE, C_LEVEL]
STAGE_2_HARD_BLOCKS.BLOCK_004: IF recipient_type IN [RECRUITER, SENIOR_TA] THEN primary_domain MUST be RECRUITING_TA

extraction_workflow.step_5: Proceed to K.3 generation with locked constraints

hard_constraints.name: Company Whitelist Enforcement
hard_constraints.rule: If K.3 generator attempts to use company not in validated_employment_list → BLOCK and retry
hard_constraints.enforcement_method: Pre-flight scan of generation buffer for company names before committing
hard_constraints.error_message: BLOCKED: Company '{company}' not in validated employment history. Allowed: {validated_employment_list}
hard_constraints.retry_strategy: Regenerate sentence with explicit constraint: 'Only mention these companies: {validated_employment_list}'

hard_constraints.name: Exact Role/Team Terminology Preservation
hard_constraints.rule: When referencing teams or roles, use EXACT phrases from team_descriptions_allowed or semantically equivalent (≥0.85 similarity)
hard_constraints.enforcement_method: Semantic similarity check on team/role mentions
hard_constraints.error_message: BLOCKED: Generic team term '{term}' used. Required: {team_descriptions_allowed}
hard_constraints.retry_strategy: Regenerate with explicit instruction: 'Use these exact team descriptions: {team_descriptions_allowed}. Do not use generic terms.'

hard_constraints.name: Metric-Context Binding
hard_constraints.rule: When using a metric, ensure required_context_keywords from metric_source_map appear in surrounding text
hard_constraints.enforcement_method: For each metric used, verify ≥1 required_context_keyword present within ±15 words
hard_constraints.error_message: BLOCKED: Metric '{metric}' used without required context. Need: {required_context_keywords}
hard_constraints.retry_strategy: Regenerate sentence to include metric with its original context

constraint_workflow.step_2: After each sentence, run all 3 hard constraint checks
constraint_workflow.step_3: If ANY constraint fails → BLOCK sentence and regenerate
constraint_workflow.step_5: Continue until full K.3 body passes all constraints

post_generation_validation.comment: LAYER 3: Expanded Post-Generation Validation - 3 New Passes

implementation.execution_timing: AFTER K.3 generation, BEFORE confidence scoring
implementation.note: These passes supplement existing LIC-QA-032-ENHANCED and LIC-QA-038-ENTITY from P8.5.1

new_validation_passes.name: Metric Source Validation
new_validation_passes.purpose: Verify every metric in K.3 has a source in metric_source_map

execution_logic.step_1: Regex extract all numbers and percentages from K.3 body
execution_logic.step_2: For each extracted metric, search metric_source_map
execution_logic.step_3: If metric NOT in map → flag as UNMAPPED_METRIC
execution_logic.step_4: If any unmapped metrics found → REJECT K.3 body

new_validation_passes.on_pass: LOG: All {count} metrics validated against source

on_fail.error_message: Metric '{metric}' has no source in resume. Allowed metrics: {metric_source_map.keys()}

new_validation_passes.name: Role Characterization Drift Detection
new_validation_passes.purpose: Detect semantic drift from specific team terminology to generic terms

execution_logic.step_1: Extract all team/role references from K.3 body
execution_logic.step_2: For each reference, find closest match in team_descriptions_allowed
execution_logic.step_5: If any reference <0.85 similarity → REJECT K.3

PASS_HIGH_SIMILARITY.allowed: senior LLM and ML engineering practice

on_fail.error_message: Team characterization drift detected. Used: '{actual}'. Expected: '{expected}' (similarity: {score})
on_fail.regeneration_constraint: Use only these team descriptions: {team_descriptions_allowed}. Never use: {forbidden_generic_terms}

new_validation_passes.name: Context Coherence Check
new_validation_passes.purpose: Verify metrics used with correct context (e.g., '5 to 18' must pair with 'ML engineering' not 'consultants')

execution_logic.step_1: For each metric in K.3, extract surrounding context (±15 words)
execution_logic.step_3: Verify ≥1 required keyword present in context
execution_logic.step_4: If any metric has NO required keywords in context → REJECT K.3

PASS_EXAMPLE.context: scaled AI/ML engineering teams from 5 to 18 members

FAIL_WRONG_CONTEXT.reason: Required context missing, wrong context used

new_validation_passes.on_pass: LOG: All metrics used in correct context

on_fail.error_message: Metric-context mismatch. Metric '{metric}' missing required context keywords: {required_context_keywords}
on_fail.regeneration_constraint: When using metric '{metric}', include these context words: {required_context_keywords}

validation_sequence.note: These 3 new passes run AFTER existing P8.5.1 passes
validation_sequence.failure_handling: ANY pass fails → REJECT K.3 and regenerate with cumulative constraints
